evidence_items.explanation: The investigation attributes the fatal Mountain View crash partly to distraction and overreliance on Autopilot, alongside system limitations and ineffective monitoring. It supports the dangerous-overreliance part of the pathway but does not identify the product name as the cause of this driver's beliefs.

evidence_items.explanation: The owner survey found substantial misunderstanding among Autopilot users, but even greater willingness to treat Super Cruise as self-driving. Differences in demographics and system design limit any claim that Tesla's naming uniquely or independently explains such behavior.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not estimate how much the names independently increase real-world crash or fatality risk.
